studies.title: Microbiological and nutritional analysis of lettuce crops grown on the International Space Station-VEG01A
studies.organism_in_metadata: Microbiota; study narrative identifies red romaine lettuce, Lactuca sativa cv. Outredgeous
studies.environmental_setup: Veggie pillows with porous arcillite substrate and controlled-release fertilizer; LED lighting; 16 h light/8 h dark; approximately 200 micromole m^-2 s^-1 PAR at pillow centre; ground controls with delay; samples frozen at -80 C
studies.limitation: ISS microgravity and ground-control crop experiment; does not provide lunar-surface yield, calorie, harvest-time, or survival guarantees.

studies.title: Pick-and-eat space crop production flight testing on the International Space Station (Elemental Analysis, ORAC, Phenolic Content)
studies.mission_metadata: SpaceX-16 and SpaceX-18; study protocol states VEG-04A 2019-06-06 through 2019-07-11 and VEG-04B 2019-10-03 through 2019-11-30
studies.organism: Mizuna, Brassica rapa var. Japonica / var. nipposinica
units: microgram per gram dry weight for elemental transformed CSV
micromole Trolox equivalents per gram dry weight for ORAC
studies.environmental_setup: 250 mL porous ceramic substrate in pillows with controlled-release fertilizer; red-rich 90%R:10%B and blue-rich 50%R:50%B treatments; pillow shade; downlinked-photo watering recommendations; ISS and ground controls
studies.harvest_design: VEG-04A terminal harvest at 35 days after initiation; VEG-04B outer-leaf harvests at 29 and 43 days and final whole-plant harvest at 58 days
known_limitations: VEG-04A fertilizer concentration caused salt stress and plant death; T70 was reduced by 47% for VEG-04B
chemistry samples pooled for some analyses; transformed files are assay outputs, not crop production models
